question: Give me the count of all under liquidation cooperatives across India.
sql: SELECT c.category, COALESCE(t.cnt,0) AS count FROM (SELECT 'Primary Cooperatives' AS category UNION ALL SELECT 'State Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'District Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'Block/Taluka/Mandal Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'Regional Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'Multistate Cooperative' UNION ALL SELECT 'State Cooperative Banks' UNION ALL SELECT 'District Cooperative Banks' UNION ALL SELECT 'Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (PCARDB)' UNION ALL SELECT 'State Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (SCARDB)') c LEFT JOIN (SELECT 'Primary Cooperatives' AS category, COUNT(*) cnt FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status=1 AND is_draft=0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state=0 AND functional_status=2 UNION ALL SELECT federation_type_name AS category, COUNT(*) FROM chatbot_state_district_federation where status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 0  AND federation_type_name IN ('State Federation','District Federation','Block/Taluka/Mandal Federation','Regional Federation') AND functional_status=2 GROUP BY federation_type_name UNION ALL SELECT 'Multistate Cooperative' AS category, COUNT(*) FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status=1 AND is_draft=0 AND is_approved <> 2 AND is_multi_state=1 AND functional_status=2 UNION ALL SELECT CASE bank_level WHEN 'SCB' THEN 'State Cooperative Banks' WHEN 'DCB' THEN 'District Cooperative Banks' WHEN 'PCARDB' THEN 'Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (PCARDB)' WHEN 'SCARDB' THEN 'State Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (SCARDB)' END AS category, COUNT(*) FROM chatbot_state_cooperative_banks WHERE status=1 AND is_delete=0 AND is_draft <> 1 AND functional_status=2 GROUP BY bank_level) t ON LOWER(TRIM(c.category)) = LOWER(TRIM(t.category));

question: Show me covered GPs in bharuch district in PACS sector
sql: SELECT sub.state_name, sub.district_name, sub.gram_panchayat_name, sub.total_villages_in_gp, sub.villages_covered, ROUND((sub.villages_covered::numeric / sub.total_villages_in_gp) * 100, 2) AS coverage_percent FROM (SELECT dbgv.state_name, dbgv.district_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_name, COUNT(DISTINCT dbgv.village_code) AS total_villages_in_gp, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) AS villages_covered FROM public.chatbot_districts_blocks_gp_villages dbgv LEFT JOIN public.chatbot_coverage_areas cr ON cr.state_code = dbgv.state_code AND cr.district_code = dbgv.district_code AND cr.panchayat_code = dbgv.gram_panchayat_code AND cr.village_code = dbgv.village_code AND cr.status = 1 AND cr.is_approved != 2 AND cr.is_draft = 0 AND (cr.sector_of_operation_name ILIKE '%pacs%' OR cr.sector_of_operation_name ILIKE '%lamps%' OR cr.sector_of_operation_name ILIKE '%farmers%') WHERE dbgv.state_name ILIKE 'gujarat' AND dbgv.district_name ILIKE 'bharuch' AND dbgv.status = 1 GROUP BY dbgv.state_name, dbgv.district_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) = COUNT(DISTINCT dbgv.village_code)) AS sub ORDER BY sub.district_name, sub.gram_panchayat_name;

question: List the quarter-wise trend of Dairy cooperative rankings in GUJARAT for 2025.
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time)=4 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time)=1 THEN 'Q1 (Jan-Mar)' WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time)=7 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time)=1 THEN 'Q2 (Apr-Jun)' WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time)=10 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time)=1 THEN 'Q3 (Jul-Sep)' WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time)=1 THEN 'Q4 (Oct-Dec)' END AS quarter, cooperative_name, total_score, rank FROM chatbot_cooperative_rankings WHERE state_name ILIKE 'GUJARAT' AND sector_name ILIKE '%Dairy Cooperative%' AND (location_of_head_quarter ILIKE '%Rural%' OR location_of_head_quarter ILIKE '%Urban%') AND rank_type_name ILIKE '%State%' AND ((EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time)=4 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_time)=2025) OR (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time)=7 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_time)=2025) OR (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time)=10 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_time)=2025) OR (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_time)=2026)) ORDER BY quarter, flag ASC, rank ASC;

question: Give me list of partially covered GPs in bharuch district in PACS sector
sql: SELECT sub.state_name, sub.district_name, sub.gram_panchayat_name, sub.total_villages_in_gp, sub.villages_covered, ROUND((sub.villages_covered::numeric / sub.total_villages_in_gp) * 100, 2) AS coverage_percent FROM (SELECT dbgv.state_name, dbgv.district_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_name, COUNT(DISTINCT dbgv.village_code) AS total_villages_in_gp, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) AS villages_covered FROM public.chatbot_districts_blocks_gp_villages dbgv LEFT JOIN public.chatbot_coverage_areas cr ON cr.state_code = dbgv.state_code AND cr.district_code = dbgv.district_code AND cr.panchayat_code = dbgv.gram_panchayat_code AND cr.village_code = dbgv.village_code AND cr.status = 1 AND cr.is_approved != 2 AND cr.is_draft = 0 AND (cr.sector_of_operation_name ILIKE '%pacs%' OR cr.sector_of_operation_name ILIKE '%lamps%' OR cr.sector_of_operation_name ILIKE '%farmers%') WHERE dbgv.state_name ILIKE 'gujarat' AND dbgv.district_name ILIKE 'bharuch' AND dbgv.status = 1 GROUP BY dbgv.state_name, dbgv.district_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) < COUNT(DISTINCT dbgv.village_code)) AS sub ORDER BY sub.district_name, sub.gram_panchayat_name;

question: All India cooperatives list
sql: SELECT c.category, COALESCE(t.cnt,0) AS count FROM (SELECT 'Primary Cooperatives' AS category UNION ALL SELECT 'State Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'District Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'Block/Taluka/Mandal Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'Regional Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'Multistate Cooperative' UNION ALL SELECT 'State Cooperative Banks' UNION ALL SELECT 'District Cooperative Banks' UNION ALL SELECT 'Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (PCARDB)' UNION ALL SELECT 'State Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (SCARDB)') c LEFT JOIN (SELECT 'Primary Cooperatives' AS category, COUNT(*) cnt FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status=1 AND is_draft=0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state=0 UNION ALL SELECT federation_type_name AS category, COUNT(*) FROM chatbot_state_district_federation where status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 0  AND federation_type_name IN ('State Federation','District Federation','Block/Taluka/Mandal Federation','Regional Federation') GROUP BY federation_type_name UNION ALL SELECT 'Multistate Cooperative' AS category, COUNT(*) FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status=1 AND is_draft=0 AND is_approved <> 2 AND is_multi_state=1 UNION ALL SELECT CASE bank_level WHEN 'SCB' THEN 'State Cooperative Banks' WHEN 'DCB' THEN 'District Cooperative Banks' WHEN 'PCARDB' THEN 'Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (PCARDB)' WHEN 'SCARDB' THEN 'State Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (SCARDB)' END AS category, COUNT(*) FROM chatbot_state_cooperative_banks WHERE status=1 AND is_delete=0 AND is_draft <> 1 GROUP BY bank_level) t ON LOWER(TRIM(c.category)) = LOWER(TRIM(t.category));

question: What is the Trend Table for top 10 Cooperative Societies in TELANGANA in the Dairy Cooperative sector for 2025?
sql: SELECT cooperative_name, district_name, full_address, total_score, rank, rank_type_name, flag FROM chatbot_cooperative_rankings WHERE state_name ILIKE 'TELANGANA' AND sector_name ILIKE '%Dairy Cooperative%' AND (location_of_head_quarter ILIKE '%Rural%' OR location_of_head_quarter ILIKE '%Urban%') AND rank_type_name ILIKE '%State%' AND CAST(date_time AS DATE) = (SELECT MAX(CAST(date_time AS DATE)) FROM chatbot_cooperative_rankings WHERE state_name ILIKE 'TELANGANA' AND sector_name ILIKE '%Dairy Cooperative%' AND (location_of_head_quarter ILIKE '%Rural%' OR location_of_head_quarter ILIKE '%Urban%') AND rank_type_name ILIKE '%State%' AND ((1 = 1 AND 2025 <> 2025 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time) = 4 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time) = 1) OR (1 = 1 AND 2025 = 2025 AND ((EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time) = 4 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time) = 30) OR (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time) = 5 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time) = 1))) OR (2 = 1 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time) = 7 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time) = 1) OR (3 = 1 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time) = 10 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time) = 1) OR (4 = 1 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time) = 1 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time) = 1)) AND ((4 = 1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_time) = 2025 + 1) OR (4 <> 1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_time) = 2025))) ORDER BY flag ASC, rank ASC LIMIT 10;

question: Sector wise list of cooperatives since MOC
sql: SELECT c.sector_of_operation_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state = 0 AND date_registration < '2021-07-06' AND sector_of_operation_name = c.sector_of_operation_name) AS "Societies (Before Formation of MOC)", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state = 0 AND date_registration >= '2021-07-06' AND sector_of_operation_name = c.sector_of_operation_name) AS "New Societies Formed (After Formation of MOC)", COUNT(c.cooperative_society_name) AS "Total Societies", ROUND((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state = 0 AND date_registration >= '2021-07-06' AND sector_of_operation_name = c.sector_of_operation_name) * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state = 0 AND date_registration < '2021-07-06' AND sector_of_operation_name = c.sector_of_operation_name), 0), 2) AS "% Increased" FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl c WHERE c.status = 1 AND c.is_draft = 0 AND c.is_approved = 1 AND c.is_multi_state = 0 GROUP BY c.sector_of_operation_name ORDER BY c.sector_of_operation_name;

question: Count of partially covered GPs in bharuch district in PACS sector

sql: SELECT sub.state_name, sub.district_name, sub.gram_panchayat_name, sub.total_villages_in_gp, sub.villages_covered, ROUND((sub.villages_covered::numeric / sub.total_villages_in_gp) * 100, 2) AS coverage_percent FROM (SELECT dbgv.state_name, dbgv.district_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_name, COUNT(DISTINCT dbgv.village_code) AS total_villages_in_gp, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) AS villages_covered FROM public.chatbot_districts_blocks_gp_villages dbgv LEFT JOIN public.chatbot_coverage_areas cr ON cr.state_code = dbgv.state_code AND cr.district_code = dbgv.district_code AND cr.panchayat_code = dbgv.gram_panchayat_code AND cr.village_code = dbgv.village_code AND cr.status = 1 AND cr.is_approved != 2 AND cr.is_draft = 0 AND (cr.sector_of_operation_name ILIKE '%pacs%' OR cr.sector_of_operation_name ILIKE '%lamps%' OR cr.sector_of_operation_name ILIKE '%farmers%') WHERE dbgv.state_name ILIKE 'gujarat' AND dbgv.district_name ILIKE 'bharuch' AND dbgv.status = 1 GROUP BY dbgv.state_name, dbgv.district_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) = COUNT(DISTINCT dbgv.village_code)) AS sub ORDER BY sub.district_name, sub.gram_panchayat_name;

question: Give me detailed list of Federations
sql: SELECT c.category, COALESCE(t.cnt, 0) AS count FROM (SELECT 'State Federation' AS category UNION ALL SELECT 'District Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'Block/Taluka/Mandal Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'Regional Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'National Federation') c LEFT JOIN (SELECT CASE WHEN federation_type_name ILIKE '%State%' THEN 'State Federation' WHEN federation_type_name ILIKE '%District%' THEN 'District Federation' WHEN federation_type_name ILIKE '%Block%' AND federation_type_name ILIKE '%Taluka%' AND federation_type_name ILIKE '%Mandal%' THEN 'Block/Taluka/Mandal Federation' WHEN federation_type_name ILIKE '%Regional%' THEN 'Regional Federation' END AS category, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM chatbot_state_district_federation where status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 0 AND (federation_type_name ILIKE '%State%' OR federation_type_name ILIKE '%District%' OR (federation_type_name ILIKE '%Block%' AND federation_type_name ILIKE '%Taluka%' AND federation_type_name ILIKE '%Mandal%') OR federation_type_name ILIKE '%Regional%') GROUP BY category UNION ALL SELECT 'National Federation' AS category, COUNT(*) FROM chatbot_national_federations WHERE is_draft = 0 AND is_new = 1) t ON LOWER(TRIM(c.category)) = LOWER(TRIM(t.category));

question: Show me the detailed sector wise list of cooperatives since formation of MOC.
sql: SELECT c.sector_of_operation_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state = 0 AND date_registration < '2021-07-06' AND sector_of_operation_name = c.sector_of_operation_name) AS "Societies (Before Formation of MOC)", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state = 0 AND date_registration >= '2021-07-06' AND sector_of_operation_name = c.sector_of_operation_name) AS "New Societies Formed (After Formation of MOC)", COUNT(c.cooperative_society_name) AS "Total Societies", ROUND((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state = 0 AND date_registration >= '2021-07-06' AND sector_of_operation_name = c.sector_of_operation_name) * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state = 0 AND date_registration < '2021-07-06' AND sector_of_operation_name = c.sector_of_operation_name), 0), 2) AS "% Increased" FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl c WHERE c.status = 1 AND c.is_draft = 0 AND c.is_approved = 1 AND c.is_multi_state = 0 GROUP BY c.sector_of_operation_name ORDER BY c.sector_of_operation_name;

question: List of partially covered GPs in bharuch district in PACS sector

question: Can you provide a detailed sector wise list of cooperatives since formation of MOC?
sql: SELECT c.sector_of_operation_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state = 0 AND date_registration < '2021-07-06' AND sector_of_operation_name = c.sector_of_operation_name) AS "Societies (Before Formation of MOC)", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state = 0 AND date_registration >= '2021-07-06' AND sector_of_operation_name = c.sector_of_operation_name) AS "New Societies Formed (After Formation of MOC)", COUNT(c.cooperative_society_name) AS "Total Societies", ROUND((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state = 0 AND date_registration >= '2021-07-06' AND sector_of_operation_name = c.sector_of_operation_name) * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state = 0 AND date_registration < '2021-07-06' AND sector_of_operation_name = c.sector_of_operation_name), 0), 2) AS "% Increased" FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl c WHERE c.status = 1 AND c.is_draft = 0 AND c.is_approved = 1 AND c.is_multi_state = 0 GROUP BY c.sector_of_operation_name ORDER BY c.sector_of_operation_name;

question: Can you provide the number of all non functional cooperatives in India?
sql: SELECT c.category, COALESCE(t.cnt,0) AS count FROM (SELECT 'Primary Cooperatives' AS category UNION ALL SELECT 'State Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'District Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'Block/Taluka/Mandal Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'Regional Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'Multistate Cooperative' UNION ALL SELECT 'State Cooperative Banks' UNION ALL SELECT 'District Cooperative Banks' UNION ALL SELECT 'Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (PCARDB)' UNION ALL SELECT 'State Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (SCARDB)') c LEFT JOIN (SELECT 'Primary Cooperatives' AS category, COUNT(*) cnt FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status=1 AND is_draft=0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state=0 AND functional_status=3 UNION ALL SELECT federation_type_name AS category, COUNT(*) FROM chatbot_state_district_federation where status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 0  AND federation_type_name IN ('State Federation','District Federation','Block/Taluka/Mandal Federation','Regional Federation') AND functional_status=3 GROUP BY federation_type_name UNION ALL SELECT 'Multistate Cooperative' AS category, COUNT(*) FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status=1 AND is_draft=0 AND is_approved <> 2 AND is_multi_state=1 AND functional_status=3 UNION ALL SELECT CASE bank_level WHEN 'SCB' THEN 'State Cooperative Banks' WHEN 'DCB' THEN 'District Cooperative Banks' WHEN 'PCARDB' THEN 'Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (PCARDB)' WHEN 'SCARDB' THEN 'State Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (SCARDB)' END AS category, COUNT(*) FROM chatbot_state_cooperative_banks WHERE status=1 AND is_delete=0 AND is_draft <> 1 AND functional_status=3 GROUP BY bank_level) t ON LOWER(TRIM(c.category)) = LOWER(TRIM(t.category));

question: What are the Top 10 quarter-wise Cooperative Societies total rank and score in TELANGANA in the Dairy Cooperative sector for 2025?
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time)=4 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time)=1 THEN 'Q1 (Jan-Mar)' WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time)=7 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time)=1 THEN 'Q2 (Apr-Jun)' WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time)=10 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time)=1 THEN 'Q3 (Jul-Sep)' WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time)=1 THEN 'Q4 (Oct-Dec)' END AS quarter, cooperative_name, total_score, rank FROM chatbot_cooperative_rankings WHERE state_name ILIKE 'TELANGANA' AND sector_name ILIKE '%Dairy Cooperative%' AND (location_of_head_quarter ILIKE '%Rural%' OR location_of_head_quarter ILIKE '%Urban%') AND rank_type_name ILIKE '%State%' AND ((EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time)=4 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_time)=2025) OR (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time)=7 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_time)=2025) OR (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time)=10 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_time)=2025) OR (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_time)=2026)) ORDER BY quarter, flag ASC, rank ASC LIMIT 10;

question: How many non functional cooperatives are there in India?
sql: SELECT c.category, COALESCE(t.cnt,0) AS count FROM (SELECT 'Primary Cooperatives' AS category UNION ALL SELECT 'State Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'District Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'Block/Taluka/Mandal Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'Regional Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'Multistate Cooperative' UNION ALL SELECT 'State Cooperative Banks' UNION ALL SELECT 'District Cooperative Banks' UNION ALL SELECT 'Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (PCARDB)' UNION ALL SELECT 'State Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (SCARDB)') c LEFT JOIN (SELECT 'Primary Cooperatives' AS category, COUNT(*) cnt FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status=1 AND is_draft=0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state=0 AND functional_status=3 UNION ALL SELECT federation_type_name AS category, COUNT(*) FROM chatbot_state_district_federation where status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 0  AND federation_type_name IN ('State Federation','District Federation','Block/Taluka/Mandal Federation','Regional Federation') AND functional_status=3 GROUP BY federation_type_name UNION ALL SELECT 'Multistate Cooperative' AS category, COUNT(*) FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status=1 AND is_draft=0 AND is_approved <> 2 AND is_multi_state=1 AND functional_status=3 UNION ALL SELECT CASE bank_level WHEN 'SCB' THEN 'State Cooperative Banks' WHEN 'DCB' THEN 'District Cooperative Banks' WHEN 'PCARDB' THEN 'Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (PCARDB)' WHEN 'SCARDB' THEN 'State Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (SCARDB)' END AS category, COUNT(*) FROM chatbot_state_cooperative_banks WHERE status=1 AND is_delete=0 AND is_draft <> 1 AND functional_status=3 GROUP BY bank_level) t ON LOWER(TRIM(c.category)) = LOWER(TRIM(t.category));

question: Give me the details of Federations.
sql: SELECT c.category, COALESCE(t.cnt, 0) AS count FROM (SELECT 'State Federation' AS category UNION ALL SELECT 'District Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'Block/Taluka/Mandal Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'Regional Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'National Federation') c LEFT JOIN (SELECT CASE WHEN federation_type_name ILIKE '%State%' THEN 'State Federation' WHEN federation_type_name ILIKE '%District%' THEN 'District Federation' WHEN federation_type_name ILIKE '%Block%' AND federation_type_name ILIKE '%Taluka%' AND federation_type_name ILIKE '%Mandal%' THEN 'Block/Taluka/Mandal Federation' WHEN federation_type_name ILIKE '%Regional%' THEN 'Regional Federation' END AS category, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM chatbot_state_district_federation where status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 0 AND (federation_type_name ILIKE '%State%' OR federation_type_name ILIKE '%District%' OR (federation_type_name ILIKE '%Block%' AND federation_type_name ILIKE '%Taluka%' AND federation_type_name ILIKE '%Mandal%') OR federation_type_name ILIKE '%Regional%') GROUP BY category UNION ALL SELECT 'National Federation' AS category, COUNT(*) FROM chatbot_national_federations WHERE is_draft = 0 AND is_new = 1) t ON LOWER(TRIM(c.category)) = LOWER(TRIM(t.category));

question: Give me the details of all cooperatives across India.

question: Sector wise cooperatives in aspirational districts

question: Count of All india non functional cooperatives
sql: SELECT c.category, COALESCE(t.cnt,0) AS count FROM (SELECT 'Primary Cooperatives' AS category UNION ALL SELECT 'State Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'District Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'Block/Taluka/Mandal Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'Regional Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'Multistate Cooperative' UNION ALL SELECT 'State Cooperative Banks' UNION ALL SELECT 'District Cooperative Banks' UNION ALL SELECT 'Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (PCARDB)' UNION ALL SELECT 'State Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (SCARDB)') c LEFT JOIN (SELECT 'Primary Cooperatives' AS category, COUNT(*) cnt FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status=1 AND is_draft=0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state=0 AND functional_status=3 UNION ALL SELECT federation_type_name AS category, COUNT(*) FROM chatbot_state_district_federation where status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 0  AND federation_type_name IN ('State Federation','District Federation','Block/Taluka/Mandal Federation','Regional Federation') AND functional_status=3 GROUP BY federation_type_name UNION ALL SELECT 'Multistate Cooperative' AS category, COUNT(*) FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status=1 AND is_draft=0 AND is_approved <> 2 AND is_multi_state=1 AND functional_status=3 UNION ALL SELECT CASE bank_level WHEN 'SCB' THEN 'State Cooperative Banks' WHEN 'DCB' THEN 'District Cooperative Banks' WHEN 'PCARDB' THEN 'Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (PCARDB)' WHEN 'SCARDB' THEN 'State Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (SCARDB)' END AS category, COUNT(*) FROM chatbot_state_cooperative_banks WHERE status=1 AND is_delete=0 AND is_draft <> 1 AND functional_status=3 GROUP BY bank_level) t ON LOWER(TRIM(c.category)) = LOWER(TRIM(t.category));

question: Give me count of partially covered GPs in bharuch district in PACS sector
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS partially_covered_gp_count FROM (SELECT dbgv.gram_panchayat_name, COUNT(DISTINCT dbgv.village_code) AS total_villages_in_gp, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) AS villages_covered FROM public.chatbot_districts_blocks_gp_villages dbgv LEFT JOIN public.chatbot_coverage_areas cr ON cr.state_code = dbgv.state_code AND cr.district_code = dbgv.district_code AND cr.panchayat_code = dbgv.gram_panchayat_code AND cr.village_code = dbgv.village_code AND cr.status = 1 AND cr.is_approved != 2 AND cr.is_draft = 0 AND (cr.sector_of_operation_name ILIKE '%pacs%' OR cr.sector_of_operation_name ILIKE '%lamps%' OR cr.sector_of_operation_name ILIKE '%farmers%') WHERE dbgv.state_name ILIKE 'gujarat' AND dbgv.district_name ILIKE 'bharuch' AND dbgv.status = 1 GROUP BY dbgv.gram_panchayat_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) < COUNT(DISTINCT dbgv.village_code)) AS sub;

question: Give me functional status wise location of headquarter count in Dairy Sector

question: Show me full covered GPs in bharuch district in PACS sector
sql: SELECT sub.state_name, sub.district_name, sub.gram_panchayat_name, sub.total_villages_in_gp, sub.villages_covered, ROUND((sub.villages_covered::numeric / sub.total_villages_in_gp) * 100, 2) AS coverage_percent FROM (SELECT dbgv.state_name, dbgv.district_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_name, COUNT(DISTINCT dbgv.village_code) AS total_villages_in_gp, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) AS villages_covered FROM public.chatbot_districts_blocks_gp_villages dbgv LEFT JOIN public.chatbot_coverage_areas cr ON cr.state_code = dbgv.state_code AND cr.district_code = dbgv.district_code AND cr.panchayat_code = dbgv.gram_panchayat_code AND cr.village_code = dbgv.village_code AND cr.status = 1 AND cr.is_approved != 2 AND cr.is_draft = 0 AND (cr.sector_of_operation_name ILIKE '%pacs%' OR cr.sector_of_operation_name ILIKE '%lamps%' OR cr.sector_of_operation_name ILIKE '%farmers%') WHERE dbgv.state_name ILIKE 'gujarat' AND dbgv.district_name ILIKE 'bharuch' AND dbgv.status = 1 GROUP BY dbgv.state_name, dbgv.district_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) = COUNT(DISTINCT dbgv.village_code)) AS sub ORDER BY sub.district_name, sub.gram_panchayat_name;

question: Count of full covered GPs in bharuch district in PACS sector
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS covered_gp_count FROM (SELECT dbgv.gram_panchayat_name, COUNT(DISTINCT dbgv.village_code) AS total_villages_in_gp, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) AS villages_covered FROM public.chatbot_districts_blocks_gp_villages dbgv LEFT JOIN public.chatbot_coverage_areas cr ON cr.state_code = dbgv.state_code AND cr.district_code = dbgv.district_code AND cr.panchayat_code = dbgv.gram_panchayat_code AND cr.village_code = dbgv.village_code AND cr.status = 1 AND cr.is_approved != 2 AND cr.is_draft = 0 AND (cr.sector_of_operation_name ILIKE '%pacs%' OR cr.sector_of_operation_name ILIKE '%lamps%' OR cr.sector_of_operation_name ILIKE '%farmers%') WHERE dbgv.state_name ILIKE 'gujarat' AND dbgv.district_name ILIKE 'bharuch' AND dbgv.status = 1 GROUP BY dbgv.gram_panchayat_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) = COUNT(DISTINCT dbgv.village_code)) AS sub;

question: Give me detailed list of All india Cooperatives
sql: SELECT c.category, COALESCE(t.cnt,0) AS count FROM (SELECT 'Primary Cooperatives' AS category UNION ALL SELECT 'State Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'District Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'Block/Taluka/Mandal Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'Regional Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'Multistate Cooperative' UNION ALL SELECT 'State Cooperative Banks' UNION ALL SELECT 'District Cooperative Banks' UNION ALL SELECT 'Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (PCARDB)' UNION ALL SELECT 'State Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (SCARDB)') c LEFT JOIN (SELECT 'Primary Cooperatives' AS category, COUNT(*) cnt FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status=1 AND is_draft=0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state=0 UNION ALL SELECT federation_type_name AS category, COUNT(*) FROM chatbot_state_district_federation where status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 0  AND federation_type_name IN ('State Federation','District Federation','Block/Taluka/Mandal Federation','Regional Federation') GROUP BY federation_type_name UNION ALL SELECT 'Multistate Cooperative' AS category, COUNT(*) FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status=1 AND is_draft=0 AND is_approved <> 2 AND is_multi_state=1 UNION ALL SELECT CASE bank_level WHEN 'SCB' THEN 'State Cooperative Banks' WHEN 'DCB' THEN 'District Cooperative Banks' WHEN 'PCARDB' THEN 'Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (PCARDB)' WHEN 'SCARDB' THEN 'State Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (SCARDB)' END AS category, COUNT(*) FROM chatbot_state_cooperative_banks WHERE status=1 AND is_delete=0 AND is_draft <> 1 GROUP BY bank_level) t ON LOWER(TRIM(c.category)) = LOWER(TRIM(t.category));

question: Give me the details of sector wise list of cooperatives since formation of MOC.
sql: SELECT c.sector_of_operation_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state = 0 AND date_registration < '2021-07-06' AND sector_of_operation_name = c.sector_of_operation_name) AS "Societies (Before Formation of MOC)", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state = 0 AND date_registration >= '2021-07-06' AND sector_of_operation_name = c.sector_of_operation_name) AS "New Societies Formed (After Formation of MOC)", COUNT(c.cooperative_society_name) AS "Total Societies", ROUND((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state = 0 AND date_registration >= '2021-07-06' AND sector_of_operation_name = c.sector_of_operation_name) * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state = 0 AND date_registration < '2021-07-06' AND sector_of_operation_name = c.sector_of_operation_name), 0), 2) AS "% Increased" FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl c WHERE c.status = 1 AND c.is_draft = 0 AND c.is_approved = 1 AND c.is_multi_state = 0 GROUP BY c.sector_of_operation_name ORDER BY c.sector_of_operation_name;

question: Give me the count of all non functional cooperatives across India.
sql: SELECT c.category, COALESCE(t.cnt,0) AS count FROM (SELECT 'Primary Cooperatives' AS category UNION ALL SELECT 'State Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'District Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'Block/Taluka/Mandal Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'Regional Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'Multistate Cooperative' UNION ALL SELECT 'State Cooperative Banks' UNION ALL SELECT 'District Cooperative Banks' UNION ALL SELECT 'Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (PCARDB)' UNION ALL SELECT 'State Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (SCARDB)') c LEFT JOIN (SELECT 'Primary Cooperatives' AS category, COUNT(*) cnt FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status=1 AND is_draft=0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state=0 AND functional_status=3 UNION ALL SELECT federation_type_name AS category, COUNT(*) FROM chatbot_state_district_federation where status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 0  AND federation_type_name IN ('State Federation','District Federation','Block/Taluka/Mandal Federation','Regional Federation') AND functional_status=3 GROUP BY federation_type_name UNION ALL SELECT 'Multistate Cooperative' AS category, COUNT(*) FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status=1 AND is_draft=0 AND is_approved <> 2 AND is_multi_state=1 AND functional_status=3 UNION ALL SELECT CASE bank_level WHEN 'SCB' THEN 'State Cooperative Banks' WHEN 'DCB' THEN 'District Cooperative Banks' WHEN 'PCARDB' THEN 'Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (PCARDB)' WHEN 'SCARDB' THEN 'State Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (SCARDB)' END AS category, COUNT(*) FROM chatbot_state_cooperative_banks WHERE status=1 AND is_delete=0 AND is_draft <> 1 AND functional_status=3 GROUP BY bank_level) t ON LOWER(TRIM(c.category)) = LOWER(TRIM(t.category));

question: Give me detailed sector wise list of cooperatives since formation of MOC
sql: SELECT c.sector_of_operation_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state = 0 AND date_registration < '2021-07-06' AND sector_of_operation_name = c.sector_of_operation_name) AS "Societies (Before Formation of MOC)", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state = 0 AND date_registration >= '2021-07-06' AND sector_of_operation_name = c.sector_of_operation_name) AS "New Societies Formed (After Formation of MOC)", COUNT(c.cooperative_society_name) AS "Total Societies", ROUND((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state = 0 AND date_registration >= '2021-07-06' AND sector_of_operation_name = c.sector_of_operation_name) * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state = 0 AND date_registration < '2021-07-06' AND sector_of_operation_name = c.sector_of_operation_name), 0), 2) AS "% Increased" FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl c WHERE c.status = 1 AND c.is_draft = 0 AND c.is_approved = 1 AND c.is_multi_state = 0 GROUP BY c.sector_of_operation_name ORDER BY c.sector_of_operation_name;

question: Detailed sector wise list of cooperatives since formation of MOC
sql: SELECT c.sector_of_operation_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state = 0 AND date_registration < '2021-07-06' AND sector_of_operation_name = c.sector_of_operation_name) AS "Societies (Before Formation of MOC)", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state = 0 AND date_registration >= '2021-07-06' AND sector_of_operation_name = c.sector_of_operation_name) AS "New Societies Formed (After Formation of MOC)", COUNT(c.cooperative_society_name) AS "Total Societies", ROUND((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state = 0 AND date_registration >= '2021-07-06' AND sector_of_operation_name = c.sector_of_operation_name) * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state = 0 AND date_registration < '2021-07-06' AND sector_of_operation_name = c.sector_of_operation_name), 0), 2) AS "% Increased" FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl c WHERE c.status = 1 AND c.is_draft = 0 AND c.is_approved = 1 AND c.is_multi_state = 0 GROUP BY c.sector_of_operation_name ORDER BY c.sector_of_operation_name;

question: Covered GPs in bharuch district for PACS sector

question: Give me count of All india Non Functional Cooperatives
sql: SELECT c.category, COALESCE(t.cnt,0) AS count FROM (SELECT 'Primary Cooperatives' AS category UNION ALL SELECT 'State Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'District Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'Block/Taluka/Mandal Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'Regional Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'Multistate Cooperative' UNION ALL SELECT 'State Cooperative Banks' UNION ALL SELECT 'District Cooperative Banks' UNION ALL SELECT 'Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (PCARDB)' UNION ALL SELECT 'State Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (SCARDB)') c LEFT JOIN (SELECT 'Primary Cooperatives' AS category, COUNT(*) cnt FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status=1 AND is_draft=0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state=0 AND functional_status=3 UNION ALL SELECT federation_type_name AS category, COUNT(*) FROM chatbot_state_district_federation where status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 0  AND federation_type_name IN ('State Federation','District Federation','Block/Taluka/Mandal Federation','Regional Federation') AND functional_status=3 GROUP BY federation_type_name UNION ALL SELECT 'Multistate Cooperative' AS category, COUNT(*) FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status=1 AND is_draft=0 AND is_approved <> 2 AND is_multi_state=1 AND functional_status=3 UNION ALL SELECT CASE bank_level WHEN 'SCB' THEN 'State Cooperative Banks' WHEN 'DCB' THEN 'District Cooperative Banks' WHEN 'PCARDB' THEN 'Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (PCARDB)' WHEN 'SCARDB' THEN 'State Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (SCARDB)' END AS category, COUNT(*) FROM chatbot_state_cooperative_banks WHERE status=1 AND is_delete=0 AND is_draft <> 1 AND functional_status=3 GROUP BY bank_level) t ON LOWER(TRIM(c.category)) = LOWER(TRIM(t.category));

question: Full covered GPs in bharuch district for PACS sector
sql: SELECT sub.state_name, sub.district_name, sub.gram_panchayat_name, sub.total_villages_in_gp, sub.villages_covered, ROUND((sub.villages_covered::numeric / sub.total_villages_in_gp) * 100, 2) AS coverage_percent FROM (SELECT dbgv.state_name, dbgv.district_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_name, COUNT(DISTINCT dbgv.village_code) AS total_villages_in_gp, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) AS villages_covered FROM public.chatbot_districts_blocks_gp_villages dbgv LEFT JOIN public.chatbot_coverage_areas cr ON cr.state_code = dbgv.state_code AND cr.district_code = dbgv.district_code AND cr.panchayat_code = dbgv.gram_panchayat_code AND cr.village_code = dbgv.village_code AND cr.status = 1 AND cr.is_approved != 2 AND cr.is_draft = 0 AND (cr.sector_of_operation_name ILIKE '%pacs%' OR cr.sector_of_operation_name ILIKE '%lamps%' OR cr.sector_of_operation_name ILIKE '%farmers%') WHERE dbgv.state_name ILIKE 'gujarat' AND dbgv.district_name ILIKE 'bharuch' AND dbgv.status = 1 GROUP BY dbgv.state_name, dbgv.district_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) = COUNT(DISTINCT dbgv.village_code)) AS sub ORDER BY sub.district_name, sub.gram_panchayat_name;

question: Please show me the latest dairy cooperatives ranking in Anand.
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time)=4 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time)=1 THEN 'Q1 (Jan-Mar)' WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time)=7 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time)=1 THEN 'Q2 (Apr-Jun)' WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time)=10 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time)=1 THEN 'Q3 (Jul-Sep)' WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time)=1 THEN 'Q4 (Oct-Dec)' END AS quarter, cooperative_name, total_score, rank FROM chatbot_cooperative_rankings WHERE state_name ILIKE '%' AND district_name ILIKE 'Anand' AND sector_name ILIKE '%Dairy Cooperative%' AND (location_of_head_quarter ILIKE '%Rural%' OR location_of_head_quarter ILIKE '%Urban%') AND rank_type_name ILIKE '%District%' AND ((EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time)=4 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_time)=2025) OR (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time)=7 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_time)=2025) OR (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time)=10 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_time)=2025) OR (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_time)=1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_time)=2026)) ORDER BY quarter, flag ASC, rank ASC LIMIT 10;

question: Give me covered GPs in bharuch district in PACS sector
sql: SELECT sub.state_name, sub.district_name, sub.gram_panchayat_name, sub.total_villages_in_gp, sub.villages_covered, ROUND((sub.villages_covered::numeric / sub.total_villages_in_gp) * 100, 2) AS coverage_percent FROM (SELECT dbgv.state_name, dbgv.district_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_name, COUNT(DISTINCT dbgv.village_code) AS total_villages_in_gp, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) AS villages_covered FROM public.chatbot_districts_blocks_gp_villages dbgv LEFT JOIN public.chatbot_coverage_areas cr ON cr.state_code = dbgv.state_code AND cr.district_code = dbgv.district_code AND cr.panchayat_code = dbgv.gram_panchayat_code AND cr.village_code = dbgv.village_code AND cr.status = 1 AND cr.is_approved != 2 AND cr.is_draft = 0 AND (cr.sector_of_operation_name ILIKE '%pacs%' OR cr.sector_of_operation_name ILIKE '%lamps%' OR cr.sector_of_operation_name ILIKE '%farmers%') WHERE dbgv.state_name ILIKE 'gujarat' AND dbgv.district_name ILIKE 'bharuch' AND dbgv.status = 1 GROUP BY dbgv.state_name, dbgv.district_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) = COUNT(DISTINCT dbgv.village_code)) AS sub ORDER BY sub.district_name, sub.gram_panchayat_name;

question: How many under liquidation cooperatives are there in India?
sql: SELECT c.category, COALESCE(t.cnt,0) AS count FROM (SELECT 'Primary Cooperatives' AS category UNION ALL SELECT 'State Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'District Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'Block/Taluka/Mandal Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'Regional Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'Multistate Cooperative' UNION ALL SELECT 'State Cooperative Banks' UNION ALL SELECT 'District Cooperative Banks' UNION ALL SELECT 'Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (PCARDB)' UNION ALL SELECT 'State Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (SCARDB)') c LEFT JOIN (SELECT 'Primary Cooperatives' AS category, COUNT(*) cnt FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status=1 AND is_draft=0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state=0 AND functional_status=2 UNION ALL SELECT federation_type_name AS category, COUNT(*) FROM chatbot_state_district_federation where status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 0  AND federation_type_name IN ('State Federation','District Federation','Block/Taluka/Mandal Federation','Regional Federation') AND functional_status=2 GROUP BY federation_type_name UNION ALL SELECT 'Multistate Cooperative' AS category, COUNT(*) FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status=1 AND is_draft=0 AND is_approved <> 2 AND is_multi_state=1 AND functional_status=2 UNION ALL SELECT CASE bank_level WHEN 'SCB' THEN 'State Cooperative Banks' WHEN 'DCB' THEN 'District Cooperative Banks' WHEN 'PCARDB' THEN 'Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (PCARDB)' WHEN 'SCARDB' THEN 'State Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (SCARDB)' END AS category, COUNT(*) FROM chatbot_state_cooperative_banks WHERE status=1 AND is_delete=0 AND is_draft <> 1 AND functional_status=2 GROUP BY bank_level) t ON LOWER(TRIM(c.category)) = LOWER(TRIM(t.category));

question: List of covered GPs in bharuch district in PACS sector
sql: SELECT sub.state_name, sub.district_name, sub.gram_panchayat_name, sub.total_villages_in_gp, sub.villages_covered, ROUND((sub.villages_covered::numeric / sub.total_villages_in_gp) * 100, 2) AS coverage_percent FROM (SELECT dbgv.state_name, dbgv.district_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_name, COUNT(DISTINCT dbgv.village_code) AS total_villages_in_gp, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) AS villages_covered FROM public.chatbot_districts_blocks_gp_villages dbgv LEFT JOIN public.chatbot_coverage_areas cr ON cr.state_code = dbgv.state_code AND cr.district_code = dbgv.district_code AND cr.panchayat_code = dbgv.gram_panchayat_code AND cr.village_code = dbgv.village_code AND cr.status = 1 AND cr.is_approved != 2 AND cr.is_draft = 0 AND (cr.sector_of_operation_name ILIKE '%pacs%' OR cr.sector_of_operation_name ILIKE '%lamps%' OR cr.sector_of_operation_name ILIKE '%farmers%') WHERE dbgv.state_name ILIKE 'gujarat' AND dbgv.district_name ILIKE 'bharuch' AND dbgv.status = 1 GROUP BY dbgv.state_name, dbgv.district_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) = COUNT(DISTINCT dbgv.village_code)) AS sub ORDER BY sub.district_name, sub.gram_panchayat_name;

question: Give me detailed state wise list of cooperatives since formation of MOC

question: Can you provide a detailed list of Federations?
sql: SELECT c.category, COALESCE(t.cnt, 0) AS count FROM (SELECT 'State Federation' AS category UNION ALL SELECT 'District Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'Block/Taluka/Mandal Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'Regional Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'National Federation') c LEFT JOIN (SELECT CASE WHEN federation_type_name ILIKE '%State%' THEN 'State Federation' WHEN federation_type_name ILIKE '%District%' THEN 'District Federation' WHEN federation_type_name ILIKE '%Block%' AND federation_type_name ILIKE '%Taluka%' AND federation_type_name ILIKE '%Mandal%' THEN 'Block/Taluka/Mandal Federation' WHEN federation_type_name ILIKE '%Regional%' THEN 'Regional Federation' END AS category, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM chatbot_state_district_federation where status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 0 AND (federation_type_name ILIKE '%State%' OR federation_type_name ILIKE '%District%' OR (federation_type_name ILIKE '%Block%' AND federation_type_name ILIKE '%Taluka%' AND federation_type_name ILIKE '%Mandal%') OR federation_type_name ILIKE '%Regional%') GROUP BY category UNION ALL SELECT 'National Federation' AS category, COUNT(*) FROM chatbot_national_federations WHERE is_draft = 0 AND is_new = 1) t ON LOWER(TRIM(c.category)) = LOWER(TRIM(t.category));

question: Give me count of All india Under Liquidation Cooperatives
sql: SELECT c.category, COALESCE(t.cnt,0) AS count FROM (SELECT 'Primary Cooperatives' AS category UNION ALL SELECT 'State Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'District Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'Block/Taluka/Mandal Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'Regional Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'Multistate Cooperative' UNION ALL SELECT 'State Cooperative Banks' UNION ALL SELECT 'District Cooperative Banks' UNION ALL SELECT 'Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (PCARDB)' UNION ALL SELECT 'State Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (SCARDB)') c LEFT JOIN (SELECT 'Primary Cooperatives' AS category, COUNT(*) cnt FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status=1 AND is_draft=0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state=0 AND functional_status=2 UNION ALL SELECT federation_type_name AS category, COUNT(*) FROM chatbot_state_district_federation where status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 0  AND federation_type_name IN ('State Federation','District Federation','Block/Taluka/Mandal Federation','Regional Federation') AND functional_status=2 GROUP BY federation_type_name UNION ALL SELECT 'Multistate Cooperative' AS category, COUNT(*) FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status=1 AND is_draft=0 AND is_approved <> 2 AND is_multi_state=1 AND functional_status=2 UNION ALL SELECT CASE bank_level WHEN 'SCB' THEN 'State Cooperative Banks' WHEN 'DCB' THEN 'District Cooperative Banks' WHEN 'PCARDB' THEN 'Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (PCARDB)' WHEN 'SCARDB' THEN 'State Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (SCARDB)' END AS category, COUNT(*) FROM chatbot_state_cooperative_banks WHERE status=1 AND is_delete=0 AND is_draft <> 1 AND functional_status=2 GROUP BY bank_level) t ON LOWER(TRIM(c.category)) = LOWER(TRIM(t.category));

question: Show me not covered GPs in bharuch district in PACS sector
sql: SELECT sub.state_name, sub.district_name, sub.gram_panchayat_name, sub.total_villages_in_gp, sub.villages_covered, ROUND((sub.villages_covered::numeric / sub.total_villages_in_gp) * 100, 2) AS coverage_percent FROM (SELECT dbgv.state_name, dbgv.district_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_name, COUNT(DISTINCT dbgv.village_code) AS total_villages_in_gp, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) AS villages_covered FROM public.chatbot_districts_blocks_gp_villages dbgv LEFT JOIN public.chatbot_coverage_areas cr ON cr.state_code = dbgv.state_code AND cr.district_code = dbgv.district_code AND cr.panchayat_code = dbgv.gram_panchayat_code AND cr.village_code = dbgv.village_code AND cr.status = 1 AND cr.is_approved != 2 AND cr.is_draft = 0 AND (cr.sector_of_operation_name ILIKE '%pacs%' OR cr.sector_of_operation_name ILIKE '%lamps%' OR cr.sector_of_operation_name ILIKE '%farmers%') WHERE dbgv.state_name ILIKE 'gujarat' AND dbgv.district_name ILIKE 'bharuch' AND dbgv.status = 1 GROUP BY dbgv.state_name, dbgv.district_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_name, dbgv.gram_panchayat_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cr.village_code) = 0) AS sub ORDER BY sub.district_name, sub.gram_panchayat_name;

question: Give me list of cooperatives in Pangi block of Chamba district in Himachal Pradesh
sql: SELECT ab.block_name AS "Block Name", cbl.cooperative_society_name AS "Cooperatives Societies", cbl.members_of_society AS "No of Members", cbl.sector_of_operation_name AS "Sector Name", cbl.gram_panchayat_name AS "GP Name", cbl.village_name AS "Covered Village" FROM chatbot_aspirational_blocks ab INNER JOIN cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl cbl ON LOWER(TRIM(cbl.block_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(ab.block_name)) AND LOWER(TRIM(cbl.state_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(ab.state_name)) AND LOWER(TRIM(cbl.district_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(ab.district_name)) WHERE cbl.is_multi_state = 0 AND cbl.is_draft = 0 AND cbl.status = 1 AND cbl.is_approved = 1 AND cbl.location_of_head_quarter = 2 AND ab.block_name ILIKE '%Pangi%' AND ab.district_name ILIKE 'Chamba' AND ab.state_name ILIKE 'Himachal Pradesh' AND ab.status = 1 ORDER BY cbl.cooperative_society_name;

question: Number of full covered GPs in bharuch district in PACS sector

question: How many cooperatives were registered each month in 2023?
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_registration) AS "Month No", TO_CHAR(date_registration, 'FMMonth') AS "Month", COUNT(*) AS "Cooperatives Registered" FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state = 0 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_registration) = 2023 GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_registration), TO_CHAR(date_registration, 'FMMonth') ORDER BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_registration);
